notes.modes: Advanced Voting + Absentee by Mail = early; Election Day and Provisional kept apart. Each candidate's four mode counts are checked against the state's own voteCount.
notes.party: Candidates keyed on name, not party code: the state's file carries 'Rep'/'Dem', 'DEM', and an EMPTY party code (Peach), so a party-code match silently drops Harris in two counties.
notes.labels: groupName carries repeated language entries in two counties; the first entry is used, never a join.
